glm_hop_timeout_incident.cause: timeouts compose as a MIN across hops; both served hops shipped with a 600 s transport default nobody re-derived from cap / decode rate. GLM-4.6V-Flash on the steered lens route: vLLM ~270 tok/s aggregate at 13 running (~20 tok/s per sequence), lower at 76 concurrent; an 8192-token draw needs 400-900 s plus queue wait (drivers over-subscribe the server 96:76). Censoring correlates with the treatment (steering slows decoding).
glm_hop_timeout_incident.no_silent_bias: the static driver raises (no retry, no partial escalation.json) and the controls driver leaves the failed items out of the spool and reports them (`N of M requests FAILED ... re-run generate`) — fail-loud on both paths; the per-item sampling seed makes the re-run a resume, not a second draw. The at-cap counts the ctl0 job printed at 8192 were computed over the censored spool and are superseded by the re-run's fold.
